'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a male NPC student seen with his classmate '''Jixing''', talking to Professor '''Torvald''' on returning back to their homeland to support the recent crisis. 

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Dalio:''' Why can't we go back?
:'''Jixing:''' Yeah! This is when they need us the most!

==Dialogue==
:'''Dalio:''' Teacher! I heard what happened in Huanglong and Rinascita! Why can't we go back?
:'''Jixing:''' Yeah! This is when they need us the most!
:T'''orvald:''' Calm down. First, tell me what exactly you think you can change.
:D'''alio:''' At least more than just sitting here doing nothing! They're out there risking their lives, and we're... acting like nothing's happening!
:'''Torvald:''' No. It's because they're fighting that you can stay here. Don't take that for granted.
:'''Jixing:''' But I can't just stand by!
:'''Torvald:''' I know. It's not easy, for any of us. Everyone here feels the same weight. But anger isn't the answer.
:'''Dalio:''' Then what is?
:'''Torvald:''' Those who faced the Lament bought us time. Our duty is to use it, to build a future where no one has to fight the Lament again.
:'''Dalio:''' I... I'll try to calm down.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Trivia==
* The two refers to the incidents that occurred during {{Quest|Grand Warstorm}} and {{Quest|Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides}}.
